title: 7-Day Sofitel Legend Metropole Colonial Hanoi Golf Tour
description: Colonial elegance meets championship golf. Stay at the legendary Sofitel Metropole and play Legend Hill, Sky Lake (Lake Course), and Silk Path Dong Trieu.

signatureTour.title: The Emperor’s Fairways
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our fully hosted northern signature itinerary featuring private colonial tours, helicopter transfers, and exclusive dining.

featuredVenues.name: Sky Lake Lake Course
featuredVenues.badge: Ahn Moon Hwan / Bori Golf Design

inclusions.detail: Executive chauffeur service for all airport and golf course journeys.
3 rounds at BRG Legend Hill, Sky Lake (Lake Course), and Silk Path Dong Trieu.
6 nights in a Historical Wing Suite at Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi.
Exclusive private access to the Metropole’s wartime bomb shelter.

itinerary.title: Arrival at the Legendary Metropole & Colonial Suite Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Colonial Heritage Arrival
itinerary.imageCaption: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive at Hanoi's Noi Bai Airport and travel by private executive transfer to the iconic Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi, operating continuously since 1901. Check in to your Historical Wing Suite with polished hardwood floors and antique ceiling fans.

Sip a classic cocktail at the Bamboo Bar by the garden pool, reflecting on the illustrious guests—from Charlie Chaplin to Graham Greene—who have walked these storied corridors.

itinerary.title: Nicklaus Twin Greens at BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Strategic Twin Greens
itinerary.imageCaption: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort — Nicklaus Design (Par 72, 7,068 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort championship golf course Nicklaus Design Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Travel north to play BRG Legend Hill Golf Resort. Jack Nicklaus's twin-green design offers fresh strategic questions on every hole, set amidst pine-covered foothills.

Return to the Metropole for a late afternoon high tea at Le Club, followed by an evening at leisure in the French Quarter.

itinerary.title: Championship Lake Course at Sky Lake Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Tournament Test
itinerary.architect: Ahn Moon Hwan / Bori Golf Design
itinerary.imageCaption: Sky Lake Lake Course — Ahn Moon Hwan / Bori Golf Design (Par 72, 6,987 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Sky Lake Lake Course championship golf course Ahn Moon Hwan / Bori Golf Design Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Take on the demanding Lake Course at Sky Lake Resort & Golf Club. Pristine turf, dramatic water carries, and steep elevation shifts test every aspect of your game.

Return to Hanoi for an exclusive private tour of the Metropole's historic wartime bomb shelter, followed by French fine dining at Le Beaulieu.

itinerary.title: Metropole Bunker History & Old Quarter Discovery
itinerary.subtitle: Heritage Day of Rest
itinerary.imageCaption: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Spend a relaxing day exploring the cultural treasures of Hanoi. Wander the tree-lined boulevards of the French Quarter, visit the historic Temple of Literature, or browse Hanoi’s artisan silk boutiques.

Enjoy an unhurried dinner at Spice Garden, the Metropole’s acclaimed Vietnamese restaurant, savoring elevated versions of classic northern dishes.

itinerary.title: Modern Parkland Challenge at Silk Path Dong Trieu
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Strategic Faldo Masterpiece
itinerary.imageCaption: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf — Sir Nick Faldo (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf championship golf course Sir Nick Faldo Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Head east to Silk Path Dong Trieu Golf, enjoying a championship parkland layout characterized by sculptured bunkering, wide fairways, and tournament-standard greens.

Relax in the clubhouse before an executive transfer returns you to Hanoi for sunset drinks overlooking Hoan Kiem Lake.

itinerary.title: West Lake Sunset Cocktails & Farewell Dinner
itinerary.subtitle: Colonial Farewell
itinerary.imageCaption: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a leisurely breakfast and a morning spa treatment at Le Spa du Metropole, releasing any remaining muscular fatigue.

Gather for a celebratory farewell dinner at Le Beaulieu, toasting a wonderful week of heritage luxury and championship golf.

itinerary.title: VIP Departure via Noi Bai International Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageCaption: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi — Luxury Sanctuary Base
itinerary.imageAlt: Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy a final morning espresso in the Metropole courtyard garden before checking out.

Your private luxury transfer delivers your party to Noi Bai International Airport for your return flight home.

faqs.question: What is the dress code at Sofitel Legend Metropole Hanoi?
faqs.answer: Smart casual attire is appreciated in all restaurants and public lounges in the evening.
